description: Returns a normalized, source-linked business record for one Orange County, CA barbershop. Use when: the user wants published services, contact information, availability class, or source links for a barbershop selected from search. Do not use when: the user needs beauty categories beyond the published barbershop subcategory, a business outside Orange County, a guaranteed live appointment slot or price, payment, or a completed booking.

business_id.description: Required stable business ID returned by search, for example crowns-barbershop.

name: details
title: Get Barbershop Details
